title: One-Pot Rice Cooker Rotisserie Chicken Rice
originalTitle: One-Pot Rice Cooker Rotisserie Chicken Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine or long-grain white rice, rinsed
2 cups chicken broth (in place of water)
2.5 cups shredded rotisserie chicken (plus a few skin/bone pieces for flavor)
4 cloves garlic, smashed & 3 slices fresh ginger
1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
3 scallions (green onions), chopped, plus chili crisp or Hainanese ginger-scallion sauce
instructions: Add the rinsed rice, chicken broth, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, smashed garlic, and ginger to a rice cooker pot (or heavy Dutch oven) and stir.
Pile the shredded rotisserie chicken directly on top of the rice without stirring it down.
Run the standard White Rice cycle (or simmer covered on low for 18 minutes, rest 10 minutes).
Fluff the aromatic chicken-infused rice together with the tender rotisserie chicken and top with fresh scallions and chili crisp.
